apps.localizedDescription:
An original viewpoint on global seismic activity, featuring maps and notifications for rapid earthquake updates. Access ten stunning base maps along with various data repositories, encompassing historical seismic events dating back to 1900. Additional map overlays are available to track wildfires, hurricanes, and active volcanoes.
Last updated: 06-30-2024
Status: ✅
